_comment: One entry per deployed property, keyed by the folder name of its app under apps/. Each app reads its own entry through getProperty() for its name, canonical URL, description and keywords, and the shared shell renders the optional sidebar groups as the property's left-hand product menu. Adding a subdomain is one entry here plus an app folder.
